text.tspan: PISA scores of 15-year-olds by reading proficiency level, 2015
Source: OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA)
Note: The cut-offs for the levels are the following: Below level 1B (below or equal to 262); level 1B (higher than 262); level 1A (higher than 335);
level 2 (higher than 407); level 3 (higher than 480) level 4 (higher than 553); level 5 (higher than 626); and level 6 (higher than 698).
